metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A beautiful, calm series that explores nature and family bonds, ideal for fans of Bluey and Clifford.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: Uses catchy music and humor to answer science and history questions, much like Numberblocks and Peg + Cat.

metas.name: Bubble Guppies
metas.description: Features a music-heavy curriculum that covers science, math, and literacy, appealing to fans of Doc McStuffins.

metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: Uses a preschool-friendly scientific method to explore how things work, similar to Ada Twist.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: Explores science and nature through play and discovery in a gentle, visually stunning format.

metas.name: Blaze and the Monster Machines
metas.description: Focuses heavily on STEM concepts like friction and trajectory, appealing to the logic seen in Numberblocks.
